prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a slow forward movement along a dimly lit pathway in East Maddon Park, London, under a heavy downpour at night. The camera steadily advances, capturing the rhythmic motion of raindrops falling against the ground and the faint glow of street lamps casting a soft blue hue over the scene. As the viewer progresses, the path curves gently to the right, revealing a chain-link fence on the left side that runs parallel to the walkway. The camera angle remains steady, focusing on the path ahead while occasionally panning slightly to the left to highlight the fence and the dark silhouettes of trees swaying in the wind. The environment is shrouded in mist, creating an eerie atmosphere as the visibility diminishes into the distance. The camera continues its forward trajectory, passing by more lampposts that intermittently illuminate the path, their light diffused by the rain. Eventually, the path leads to a set of stairs ascending into the darkness, flanked by more fencing and trees. The camera ascends the stairs, offering a brief upward view before leveling out again, revealing a continuation of the park's expanse, now bordered by a dense line of trees and another section of fencing. The entire sequence maintains a consistent pace, emphasizing the solitary and tranquil nature of the nocturnal stroll through the empty urban park.
location: East Maddon Park, London, United Kingdom
